text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen, Daitaku Helios reigns 
supreme! Witnessing that miracle, K.S. 
Miracle's vibes shoot up, yearning to run 
just like that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby flashes a full smile. With 
the pride of her "clan" in her heart, she 
vows to rise once again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby's smile is mega cute. But... 
Daitaku Helios realized something: running 
for someone else's sake is way too 
exhausting.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
He realized that Daiichi Ruby and the 
others had been running all this time 
carrying these heavy feelings. The world 
they saw was entirely different.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My fave doesn't smile like I do. But—she's 
got an irreplaceable bestie. All that's 
left is to throw a massive party and rage 
together forever!
